Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE reusable native-grid pixel-art sprite for the existing Tomade 2D game UI.
Reference image: the green tiled stove is the STYLE MASTER, not the object to include.
Match its restrained pixel work: thin continuous ONE-native-pixel dark outline, single-pixel highlights, simple two/three flat tones per material, straight horizontal edges and short crisp staircase corners. Same pixel density in WORLD SPACE as a stove 56 pixels wide and 115 pixels tall. Objects must look like one artist drew the entire tileset. Larger furniture has MORE pixels across its surface, NOT thicker/blockier pixels. Small furniture has LESS detail, NOT tiny intricate strokes.
Orthogonal elevated RPG view, front edge horizontal, top surface visible, no isometric diagonal view.
Quiet honey oak, muted sage/teal, slate blue iron, warm ivory. No glossy shading, gradients, grain, realistic wood streaks, sketchy uneven outlines or tiny subpixel detail.
Output one complete isolated object centered, with generous padding on perfectly solid RGB(255,0,255) magenta for the existing color-key loader. Magenta also fills all holes. No cast shadow, floor, room, other objects, text, labels, measurements or grids.

No monitor, chair or nameplate. Thin outline only ONE out of the 138 pixels across the desk; no thick black frame. Plain surfaces, remove wood grain completely.
